subject_lessons.subject: math
subject_lessons.title: Y2 Math: Place Value (Hundreds, Tens, Ones) & 2-Digit Addition
subject_lessons.story:
TRADITIONAL MATH LESSON (GRADE 2):
In a 3-digit number like 245:
  • 2 is in the Hundreds place (200)
  • 4 is in the Tens place (40)
  • 5 is in the Ones place (5)
We also classify numbers as Even (0, 2, 4, 6, 8) or Odd (1, 3, 5, 7, 9).

subject_lessons.coding_challenge:
# 📐 YEAR 2 MATH ASSIGNMENT: Place Value Breakdown
score = 245
hundreds = score // 100
tens = (score % 100) // 10
ones = score % 10
print(f'{score} = {hundreds} hundreds + {tens} tens + {ones} ones')
assert hundreds * 100 + tens * 10 + ones == score

subject_lessons.story:
TRADITIONAL SCIENCE LESSON (GRADE 2):
1. States of Matter: Ice is a Solid, ocean water is a Liquid, and air/steam is a Gas.
2. Ocean Habitat Food Chain:
   Sunlight & Kelp (Producers) -> Green Fish (Prey Herbivores) -> Red Sharks (Predators).
   Every living thing needs energy from food to survive and grow!

subject_lessons.title: Y2 Reading & Grammar: Nouns, Action Verbs & Finding the Main Idea
subject_lessons.story:
TRADITIONAL LANGUAGE ARTS LESSON (GRADE 2):
• A NOUN is a person, place, or thing (like `rocket`, `ocean`, `fish`, `star`).
• A VERB is an action word that tells what a noun does (like `swim`, `dodge`, `steer`, `land`).
• Main Idea: The most important point an author wants you to learn in a paragraph.

subject_lessons.story:
TRADITIONAL SOCIAL STUDIES LESSON (GRADE 2):
Earth has 7 Continents (North America, South America, Europe, Africa, Asia, Australia, Antarctica) and 5 Oceans (Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern, Arctic).
Historians use a Timeline to order events from Past -> Present -> Future!
